rows.Kwic: 。舉起拄杖云：速退！速退！問：如何是接初機句？師云：汝是行脚僧。進云：如何是辨衲僧句？師云：西方日出卯。進云：如何是正令行時句？師云：千里特來呈舊面。進云：如何是立乾坤句？師云：北俱盧洲長粳米，食者無貪亦不嗔。師又云：秖將此四轉語驗天下

Override.AttributionNote: 天聖廣燈錄, Fenyang Shanzhao section. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed questioning monk: he asks for the phrase when the true command is carried out; Fenyang answers. All six rungs leave the monk unnamed.

rows.Kwic: 但自迴光返照，向自己脚根下子細推尋，看是箇什麼？

Override.AttributionNote: 天聖廣燈錄, Chengtian Cique section. Chengtian Cique is the exact hall speaker who tells the assembly to turn the light around and reflect back, then investigate carefully beneath their own heels.

rows.Kwic: 各請迴光返照，休更踟躕。

Override.AttributionNote: 天聖廣燈錄, Jueke Xinyin section. Jueke Xinyin is the exact speaker who closes his mirror-and-moon address by asking everyone to turn the light around and reflect back without further hesitation.
